description: Detail Plan areas — Sewer is a dataset listed in Brisbane Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Brisbane City Council. Brisbane City Council detail plan areas can be used to locate the relevant Detail Plans on Brisbane Images. The Detail Plans provide a dated record of Brisbane ’ s built environment in addition to contour levels. They were initially created to plan for installation of sewerage pipes across the city. Coverage: Brisbane, Queensland. The portal files it under Property and Planning. Its keywords are arcgis, property and planning, built environment, contour, drainage, historic. The portal shows 2,491 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-08-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-brisbane-qld-gov-au-portal.
